inputs.original_text: Workers employed in the support programmes of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth staged a protest outside the Presidential Palace on Thursday and announced a 24-hour strike, calling for legally binding job security guarantees — even as the government argued it had already delivered on the most significant demands. At the heart of the [...]
inputs.modified_text:
Look at this utter breakdown of basic order and responsibility. On Thursday, workers in the support programmes of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth had the audacity to stage a protest outside the Presidential Palace and announce a 24-hour strike. They are demanding legally binding job security guarantees, completely ignoring the basic reality of personal responsibility and the fact that the government has already delivered on the most significant demands. 

Instead of showing respect for authority and civic stability, these agitators are disrupting the system and threatening the foundational duties of our public institutions. When people abandon duty and demand unconditional guarantees instead of earning their place through honest work, the very fabric of our society and its traditional values are undermined. At the heart of the matter, we are seeing a total collapse of respect for governance and the rule of law.
